sentences.en: Do you wanna come to the riverside with me tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 1. 明天你愿意和我一起去河岸散步吗？

sentences.en: Come on! It's so nice out. We're going to the riverside.
sentences.zh: 2. 快点儿！天气这么好。我们要去河畔了。

sentences.en: We can go take a walk on the riverside.
sentences.zh: 3. 我们可以去河边散散步。

phrases.zh: 沿着河岸：沿河走；在河边
